text:
Nina: Heads up — CLI 0.12.1 isn't picking up rotated short-lived API keys during sample-app onboarding. Seen this with a couple of customers, blocking onboarding.
Sam: oof, @Nina can you paste exact env var names and steps? docs have a few variants. :eyes:
Nina: Using REDWOOD_API_KEY (export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...) then run `redwood whoami` -> token expired. Repro below.
Nina: repro log:
```
$ export REDWOOD_API_KEY=eyJhbGciOiJI...rotated
$ redwood whoami
Error: token expired (401)
```
Raj: Is this the CLI credential provider caching tokens in memory? we added a 5m cache for perf earlier.
Sam: CLI should re-read env vars on every invocation. caching env-sourced creds sounds wrong unless it's file-based.
Nina: I think the provider caches the parsed token and doesn't re-evaluate if env var changes between runs (shell replace). happens when we rotate keys server-side.
devx-bot: issue created: #3456 — cli: env-sourced credentials not invalidating on env change (assigned: Andy)
Andy: I'll take this. quick plan: stop caching env-sourced tokens across CLI commands, add quick TTL revalidation (<60s), add unit for sample-app flow.
Sam: Also let's standardize the env var names in docs. I keep finding REDWOOD_KEY, REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_TOKEN across guides. pick one.
Nina: Prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY + REDWOOD_PROJECT for scoping. sample-app onboarding expects project-scoped keys but whoami currently prints org only.
Raj: Good call — whoami should surface project if the key is project-scoped. otherwise people think rotation failed.
Andy: I'll update CLI to: 1) re-read env vars at start of each command, 2) if cached token expiry < 60s trigger refresh/reauth, 3) print org/project info when available.
Nina: Can you also add a tiny migration note in onboarding docs about short-lived keys & rotation? customers hit this when rotating via our console.
Sam: I'll open a docs PR and a small changelog entry. Also suggest adding a fallback of reading from `redwood config get api_key` for sample-apps (non-env path).
Andy: Working on a patch branch now. aiming for a patch release within 2 hours. I'll ping here with the release commit + changelog.
Nina: Amazing, TY! please @me when deployed — several trials are waiting. :raised_hands:
Sam: :thumbsup:
Raj: Thanks all — agree this fixes onboarding friction and keeps SDK parity across language SDKs.
